Conclusion

Total 11 test steps executed. 4 passed, 2 warnings, 5 failed.

Core Function Verification:
1. Demo page renders correctly with all UI elements
2. Remote browser starts and connects successfully
3. External websites (Baidu) load and display normally
4. WebSocket connection remains stable, session management works
5. Browser viewer streaming quality is excellent
6. Credit billing system functions properly

Known Issues:
1. FPS/bandwidth metrics show "--" in performance panel - streaming monitor may not be reporting correctly
2. Navigate to localhost:3011 fails (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED) - remote browser runs on a different machine, cannot access management server's localhost

Recommended Fixes:
1. Use external IP (192.168.0.29:3011) instead of localhost for navigation tests
2. Debug FPS/bandwidth reporting logic to ensure data reaches the frontend panel
